title: Equipment Predictive Maintenance
thesis: Snowflake predicts equipment failures before they happen — IoT telemetry, ML forecasting, and automated alerts, all in one platform without external ML infrastructure

talking_points: RM 12 million in unplanned downtime costs this year across 120 critical semiconductor tools.
Eight tools currently in ALARM state — vibration, temperature, or pressure exceeding spec.
72-hour prediction window: ML.FORECAST identifies degradation before operators notice.
show: Point at RM 12M downtime cost KPI
tabs.call_out: 8 tools in ALARM — RM 12M annual unplanned downtime

transition.line: Let's look at which tools are degrading and what the sensors tell us.

talking_points: EQ-0023 — Applied Materials etch chamber — vibration trending 2.3x above baseline over 14 days.
ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION confirms: 9 of the last 14 days show anomalous sensor patterns.
Remaining useful life estimate: 68 hours before predicted failure threshold.
show: Show vibration trend with anomaly markers
tabs.call_out: EQ-0023: 68 hours remaining useful life — ML.FORECAST

transition.line: The degradation is clear. Let's see what the system recommends.

talking_points: ML.FORECAST projects remaining useful life for all 120 tools — updated every 4 hours.
Three tools predicted to fail within 72 hours: EQ-0023 (etch), EQ-0067 (CVD), EQ-0091 (implant).
Spare parts check: bearing assembly for EQ-0023 in stock, 2-day lead time for CVD chamber seal.
show: Show RUL forecast chart with confidence bands
tabs.call_out: 3 tools predicted to fail within 72 hours — proactive maintenance possible

transition.line: Let the Maintenance Director ask the system what to prioritize.

talking_points: Rajesh asks: 'Which tools should I schedule for maintenance this week?'
Cortex Analyst queries health scores, returns prioritized list with cost impact.
Switch to advisor: 'What's the corrective action for EQ-0023 vibration?' — searches maintenance docs.
show: Type: 'Which tools need maintenance this week?'
Switch to advisor for corrective actions
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: maintenance analytics + corrective action advisor

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake, streaming IoT to prediction.

talking_points: IoT Core streams 1 million sensor readings via Snowpipe Streaming — sub-second latency.
ML.FORECAST retrains every 4 hours, alerts fire automatically via Notification Integration.
120 tools monitored, 3,000 work orders tracked, 100 maintenance documents searchable.
tabs.call_out: IoT to prediction to alert — one platform, no external ML

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — predictive maintenance for semiconductor manufacturing.
